title: Media Call: Galveston Gulf Ledger Asks About a Death on the Dawn

fields.to: VP Communications / cc Director of Public Health
fields.message: A passenger in the Roll Call Facebook group says an elderly woman died in the Halcyon Dawn's medical center this afternoon and the doctors were 'all in gowns'. Was it norovirus? Is it the first norovirus death on a cruise ship this year? What is today's case count? Email: newsdesk@galvestongulfledger.example. NOTE FROM GUEST CARE, 17:00: Son reached at 16:20. He asks us to hold off until he has told his sister in Austin. He will call back by 18:30.

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Comms should not confirm the death or guess its cause while the family is still being told. It should give only the signed count with its time: 98 passengers (3.3%) and 27 crew (2.4%), signed at 12:20 Saturday. That figure goes out with the holding statement, and "we do not know yet" is an acceptable answer. Public Health should check the Facebook post against the medical log within 30 minutes and confirm that the count matches the CDC reports.
